#!/usr/bin/env bash
# autogate.sh <TESSERA|Gitbook> <pr-number> [--merge]
# Shallow-clones the PR, runs local tests on Node 22, gitleaks, noreply check, workflow/flag guard.
set -euo pipefail
REPO=$1; PR=$2; MERGE=${3:-}
NOREPLY=332565808+vitalitychems-dot@users.noreply.github.com
GITLEAKS=${GITLEAKS:-/workspace/pubscan/gitleaks}; GLCONF=${GLCONF:-/workspace/pubscan/gl.toml}
W=$(mktemp -d /workspace/dispatch/gate-XXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$W"' EXIT
cd "$W"; git init -q r; cd r; git remote add origin "https://github.com/vitalitychems-dot/$REPO"
git fetch -q --filter=blob:none --depth 50 origin "main:refs/remotes/origin/main" "pull/$PR/head:pr"
# Gitbook is ~11G: check out only the files the PR changes; TESSERA needs the full tree for tests.
if [ "$REPO" = Gitbook ]; then git sparse-checkout init --no-cone -q 2>/dev/null || git sparse-checkout init --no-cone; git diff --name-only origin/main...pr | git sparse-checkout set --no-cone --stdin; fi
git checkout -q pr
BASE=origin/main; fail(){ echo "GATE FAIL: $*"; exit 1; }
git diff --name-only $BASE...HEAD > ../files
rg -q '^\.github/workflows/' ../files && fail "touches .github/workflows"
git diff $BASE...HEAD | rg -q '^\+.*TESSERA_ENABLE_[A-Z_]+\s*[:=]\s*["'"'"']?(1|true)' && fail "enables a TESSERA_ENABLE flag"
BAD=$(git log $BASE..HEAD --format='%ae' | sort -u | rg -v "^($NOREPLY|.*@users\.noreply\.github\.com)$" || true)
[ -n "$BAD" ] && fail "non-noreply author: $BAD"
"$GITLEAKS" git --log-opts="$BASE..HEAD" ${GLCONF:+--config "$GLCONF"} . >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "gitleaks findings"
node -v | rg -q '^v22' || fail "need Node 22 on PATH"
if [ "$REPO" = TESSERA ]; then
  pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null
  (cd artifacts/v2 && npm test >/dev/null) || fail "v2 tests"
  (cd artifacts/gitai && npm test >/dev/null) || fail "gitai tests"
  (cd artifacts/api-server && env -u DATABASE_URL npx vitest run --reporter=dot > ../../../api.log 2>&1) || {
    # tolerate only files that fail at import because DATABASE_URL is unset
    rg -q 'Tests .*failed' ../api.log && fail "api-server test failures"
    rg 'FAIL ' ../api.log | rg -v 'DATABASE_URL|database not configured' -q && fail "api-server non-DB failure" || true; }
fi
echo "GATE PASS $REPO#$PR $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
[ "$MERGE" = --merge ] && gh pr merge "$PR" -R "vitalitychems-dot/$REPO" --squash --author-email "$NOREPLY"

def open_pr_files(repo):
    out = subprocess.run(["gh", "pr", "list", "-R", f"vitalitychems-dot/{repo}", "--state", "open", "--json", "number,files"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout or "[]"

import sys,os,json,argparse,subprocess,time
import qlab  # noqa: path setup
import numpy as np
def load_circ(p):
    d=json.load(open(p)); n=d['n']; c=[]
    from aqft import aqft
    for g in d['gates']:
        if g[0] in ('QFT','AQFT'): c+=aqft(g[1][0],g[1][1] if g[0]=='AQFT' else g[1][0])
        else: c.append((g[0],list(g[1]))+tuple(g[2:]))
    return n,c
def optimize(args):
    from calib import load; from route import route,best_layouts; from twin import run,esp
    from qopt import optimize as v1; from qopt2 import lower; from qopt3 import optimize3; import qnoise2
    from qsim import SV
    t0=time.time(); n,c=load_circ(args.circuit); dev=load(args.device); L=lower(c)
    if n<=8:
        psi=SV(n).run(L).v; sc=lambda x:qnoise2.fidelity(n,x,psi)
        o,_=optimize3(lower(v1(L)),sc)
    else: o=lower(v1(L))
    o=[g if g[0]!='CZ' else g for g in o]
    def stats(x): return dict(gates=len(x),twoq=sum(len(g[1])==2 for g in x))
    from route import connected_subsets
    naive=tuple(sorted(connected_subsets(dev,n,limit=1)[0]))
    def pred(lay):
        rc,ph,sw,fin=route(dev,lay,o); out=dict(layout=list(lay),swaps=sw,esp=float(esp(dev,ph,rc)),routed=stats(rc),final_positions=fin)
        if n<=8 and not args.no_twin:
            p=SV(n).run(rc).v; out['twin_fidelity']=float(np.real(p.conj()@run(dev,ph,rc,n)@p))
        return out,rc
    nv,_=pred(naive); cands=[pred(l[1]) for l in best_layouts(dev,o,n,top=3)]
    key='twin_fidelity' if 'twin_fidelity' in nv else 'esp'
    best,brc=max(cands,key=lambda z:z[0][key])
    res=dict(device=dev['name'],calibration_source=dev['source'],n=n,input=stats(L),optimized=stats(o),
             naive_layout=nv,best_layout=best,optimized_circuit=[list(g[:2])+list(g[2:]) for g in o],
             routed_circuit=[list(g[:2])+list(g[2:]) for g in brc],seconds=round(time.time()-t0,2),
             note='twin_fidelity = state fidelity from |0..0> under the calibrated twin (no readout). Predicted, not measured on hardware.')
    s=json.dumps(res,default=lambda x:list(x) if isinstance(x,tuple) else float(x),indent=1)
    (open(args.out,'w').write(s) if args.out else print(s))
